$description: Structured copy of the Android answers on DREAMT-4719 (2026-11-19) that scripts read. Source data: do not edit. Wording and full answer: 2026-11-19-DREAMT-4719-android.md in this folder.
source: Rajal Patel, DREAMT-4719 comments 276725 and 276735, 2026-11-19; android-tribpub (commit not stated; our export is 1cfb069a6)

statusbar_tsar.note: Barely visible white icons on the off-white bar (MISSING-ASSETS 5.5: production is not white with dark icons)

top_bar.title: Roboto Medium 16sp, all caps
top_bar.title_exceptions: Restaurants and the corekit settings screen use the plain AppCompat title: Roboto Medium 20 (answer says 20dp)

buttons.system: No app-wide button style; plain Buttons get Material library defaults
buttons.main_screens: MaterialComponents theme: Roboto Medium 14sp, ALL CAPS, letterSpacing 0.0893
buttons.m3_screens: Settings / web view / paywall (Material3 theme): Roboto Medium 14sp, sentence case, line height 20sp
buttons.pressed: None designed. Material ripple on Material buttons, ?selectableItemBackground ripple on some views; the monthly subscription option has no pressed state. Legacy selectors: What's New close pressed #FF6859; update-app dialog button #076C9C → #6E8D9B pressed.

alerts_enable.label: Roboto Medium 14sp, all caps, white
alerts_enable.alerts_tab: The Alerts-tab "Enable Alerts" is a system AlertDialog button

whats_new.label: Open Sans Bold 14sp (18sp landscape, 25sp tablet), all caps, white

settings_background.why: The Settings theme paints the window and every view white in the ~70 markets that keep #333333; ct, dp, hc, mc, nydn, tod, vp set Settings_Background itself to white

skip.material_ok: Material Symbols' 10 s icons work as they are

fonts_45.NYDN: OpenSansCondensed-Bold.ttff does not load; falls back to Roboto Regular (time/blurb line in notification and stream lists). Fix: rename to .ttf
fonts_45.MC: OpenSans-Semibold.ttf would not load, but Article_Byline_Regular / Article_Dateline_Regular are not referenced by any style; MC bylines and datelines use OpenSans-Bold.ttf

widget.size: minWidth 300dp, minHeight 170dp, target 2×1 cells, not resizable, refreshes every 30 min
widget.layout: 16dp rounded card, 16dp padding. Date 12sp top-right. Logo 145 × 25dp. 2dp divider1. Lead row: 66dp-wide thumbnail (7dp corners), bold 15sp headline (max 3 lines). 2px divider2 at 12dp. Second headline bold 16sp (max 2 lines).

type_styles.$description: Android text styles the export does not have, answered by the Apps team; scripts/android_answered_type.py adds them to the Android source before compare_type.py and build_type_tokens.py read it.

App.name: toolbar-title
App.usage: Top bar title: Roboto Medium 16sp, all caps (MC.TextAppearance.AppCompat.Widget.ActionBar.Title). Restaurants and the corekit settings screen use the plain AppCompat title, Roboto Medium 20dp (fixed dp). Apps team, DREAMT-4719 (2026-11-19).
App.exceptions: Restaurants and the corekit settings screen: plain AppCompat title, Roboto Medium 20dp (fixed dp, does not follow the system font size; Android style guide 1795110354-0c21)

style_guide_update.$description: Rajal Patel updated the Android style guide with these answers (DREAMT-4719 comment 276747, 2026-11-19); guide version 1795110354-0c21, still android-tribpub 1cfb069a6. Facts below are copied from the guide pages, not inferred.
style_guide_update.top_bar_title_exception_unit: dp on purpose: 'nothing is fixed except dp-sized AppCompat toolbar titles (20dp)' (2-type-by-market)
style_guide_update.section_tab: Open Sans SemiBold 12sp (confirmed; no 14sp variant), 48dp, 12dp side padding, scrollable
style_guide_update.breaking_news: Section-front list item; padding 10dp (24dp sides at sw600dp); text 60dp right margin; close 40dp; Open Sans Bold 14sp white on #cf000e, 2dp white line under it. Height follows the content.
style_guide_update.whats_new_fill: whats_new_button_color per market; CT #9dd1f5, NYDN #4591e0, VP #005f7e override the drawable (5-controls) — matches our data
style_guide_update.alerts_enable_fill: Guide: Alerts_Enable_Button_Background = #ff6859 in every market (5-controls). Our export at 1cfb069a6 has per-market values: still to clarify (MISSING-ASSETS 5.6)
style_guide_update.tsar_white: TSAR redefines @color/white as #f5f5f5, so its bar and segmented selected fill are off-white (1-market-colors)
style_guide_update.breaking_news_banner_background: BreakingNews_Banner_Background is defined but never used; the overlay uses br_news_red #cf000e
style_guide_update.home_icon: 77 markets ship their own Home tab icon (mc_tab_icon_latestnews); only the Home tab icon is per market (comment 276747, 1.4)
style_guide_update.condensed_fonts: Open Sans Condensed is Google's legacy static release: OpenSansCondensed-Bold.ttf (Bold 700, v1.11) and OpenSans-Regular-Condensed.ttf = OpenSansCondensed-Light (Light 300, v1.10) renamed. No Light Italic. NYDN uses these shared copies (4.1, Android)
style_guide_update.article_text_size: 4 options Small / Medium (default) / Large / Extra Large; each adds -2 / 0 / +2 / +4 x 1.6 raw px (not dp), about 93 / 100 / 107 / 114 % of 15sp on xxhdpi. Bugs: the saved choice is not re-applied after a cold start (FontSizeManager.init() never called); the Settings text-size entry is in no preference XML and its handler is empty (4.2, Android)
style_guide_update.dark_mode: README: Settings, web views, login/paywall and Your News topics use a DayNight theme with nothing forcing light, so they follow the device's dark setting for theme defaults
